name: Chiral autocatalysis with recycling in a reaction volume diluted by serial transfer
question: Is the handedness of a reaction volume inherited when it is diluted below the critical content and refilled?
assumptions: k1 = 0, kappa2 = 4e-3 k0, lambda = k0 (Section 5 of the source); time in units of 1/k0
growth: achiral substrate supplied at a constant rate at fixed volume, so the content c rises linearly (rate 1 per unit time)
division: serial transfer at the content 64; each molecule is kept with probability 1/2 (binomial partition) and the volume is made up with solvent
a vessel omega = 16 times the source volume at the same concentrations; the intrinsic noise as the chemical Langevin equation of the four reactions

provenance.source: Y. Saito, T. Sugimori and H. Hyuga, J. Phys. Soc. Jpn. 76, 044802 (2007), eqs. (5)-(8), (31); arXiv cond-mat/0612385
